id.description: The version's own id: what a link, and the accept route, name.

key.description: The family this is a version of.

type.description: What an agreement family is: terms, or a privacy notice. A property of the family rather than of one version, so every version published under one `key` classifies the same way.

allOf.description: What an agreement family is: terms, or a privacy notice. A property of the family rather than of one version, so every version published under one `key` classifies the same way.
allOf.title: AgreementType

version.description: Monotonic within the family, from 1. The engine derives it; nobody submits it.

total.description: Rows matching the filters, across all pages.

400.description: The body or query violates its declared shape; `message` names each violated rule.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.

403.description: The token verifies but its `roles` claim holds none of `ADMIN_REQUIRED_ROLES`; signing in again cannot fix this.
